turns.replyTail:
to get started?

To enjoy your Eternity® flowers for a year or more, care is remarkably simple. Just keep them in a room-temperature environment, away from direct sunlight and excess humidity.
The two most important rules to remember are: never water the flowers, and leave them safely inside their box or vessel—they are designed to stay there for their entire lifespan. A light duster can be used occasionally if dust collects.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your Le Mini Round for the first time is completely effortless. When it arrives, simply unbox it and place it in your desired room-temperature space—there is no assembly or setup needed.
Just keep the rose in its box, avoid watering it, and keep it out of direct sunlight. If dust gathers over time, a light dusting is all it takes to keep it looking pristine.
